assertion: SVG file path: Object-box radial gradients scale into non-square rectangles. Off-center focus moves the bright origin; a nonzero focal radius preserves a flat inner region before the ramp.

browser.reason: Reviewed the centered, displaced and finite-radius focal regions in all three browsers. Firefox differs only by one channel level in 4190 ramp pixels; the white inner region and solid outer color agree exactly. Chrome dithers more pixels and WebKit reaches three levels.
